description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' responsible for rendering an interactive mind map visualization using SVG. It includes layout computations, node rendering, edge drawing, and user interactions such as zoom and pan. The file is part of a larger project focused on visualizing career transition pathways, with nodes representing skills, roles, and steps, and edges denoting relationships or progressions.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty if null.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number or null if conversion fails.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Extracts percentage range data from a node for display in the diagram.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a node represents a step or milestone in the pathway.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates hierarchical levels of nodes based on edges and a center node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Determines visual lane placement for a node based on its attributes.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds adjacency maps for source/target relationships among nodes.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the primary node on the right side based on hierarchy levels.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Computes positions and connections for all nodes in the mind map, following a specified design layout.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Splits long text into multiple lines with word wrapping, adding ellipses if needed.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: React component that renders the interactive mind map SVG with zoom, pan, and click interaction for nodes.
